BIM = BIM or {} local M = BIM -- Debug logging to the board console / game log (grep the log for "[BIM]"). -- Toggle off with the `debug` export. -- NOTE: in DU, injected globals (system, unit, slot1..slot10) must be referenced -- directly by name, not through the global table -- so we do that everywhere below. local function dbg(msg) if M.debug == false then return end if system and system.print then system.print("[BIM] " .. tostring(msg)) end end local function round1(n) return math.floor(n * 10 + 0.5) / 10 end function M.formatVolume(liters) liters = liters or 0 if liters < 1000 then return string.format("%d L", math.floor(liters + 0.5)) end if liters < 1000000 then return string.format("%s kL", round1(liters / 1000)) end if liters < 1000000000 then return string.format("%s ML", round1(liters / 1000000)) end return string.format("%s GL", round1(liters / 1000000000)) end function M.formatMass(kg) return string.format("%.1f t", (kg or 0) / 1000) end function M.formatPct(pct) pct = pct or 0 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 100 then pct = 100 end return string.format("%d%%", math.floor(pct + 0.5)) end local MAX_SLOTS = 10 -- a Programming Board exposes slot1..slot10 -- Best-effort in-game name of a linked element handle (Element.getName()). local function handleName(c, idx) local label = nil pcall(function() label = c.getName() end) if label == nil or label == "" then label = "Container " .. tostring(idx) end return label end -- Read one linked container/hub handle into a row record. local function readContainer(c, idx) local label = handleName(c, idx) local vol = c.getItemsVolume() local maxVol = c.getMaxVolume() local mass = c.getItemsMass() local pct = 0 if maxVol and maxVol > 0 then pct = (vol / maxVol) * 100 end return { label = label, vol = vol or 0, maxVol = maxVol or 0, mass = mass or 0, pct = pct, ok = true } end -- Build rows from an array of container/hub handles (already filtered). -- Each handle is labelled by its own getName(); a failed read becomes ok=false. function M.buildRows(containers) local rows = {} for i = 1, #containers do local c = containers[i] if c ~= nil then local ok, row = pcall(readContainer, c, i) if ok then rows[#rows + 1] = row else rows[#rows + 1] = { label = handleName(c, i), vol = 0, maxVol = 0, mass = 0, pct = 0, ok = false } end end end return rows end -- Classify an array of linked slot handles into a screen + container list. -- Each handle exposes getClass(); screens match "Screen", containers/hubs match "Container". function M.classify(slots) local screen, containers = nil, {} for i = 1, #slots do local s = slots[i] if s ~= nil then local cls = nil pcall(function() cls = s.getClass() end) cls = cls or "" if (not screen) and cls:find("Screen", 1, true) then screen = s elseif cls:find("Container", 1, true) then containers[#containers + 1] = s end end end return { screen = screen, containers = containers } end function M.sortRows(rows, mode) if mode == "none" then return rows end local cmp if mode == "fill-asc" then cmp = function(a, b) return a.pct < b.pct end elseif mode == "name" then cmp = function(a, b) return tostring(a.label) < tostring(b.label) end else -- "fill-desc" default cmp = function(a, b) return a.pct > b.pct end end table.sort(rows, cmp) return rows end function M.aggregate(rows) local totalVol, totalMax, count = 0, 0, 0 for _, r in ipairs(rows) do if r.ok then totalVol = totalVol + (r.vol or 0) totalMax = totalMax + (r.maxVol or 0) count = count + 1 end end local pct = 0 if totalMax > 0 then pct = math.floor((totalVol / totalMax) * 100 + 0.5) end return { totalVol = totalVol, totalMax = totalMax, pct = pct, count = count } end function M.classifyLevel(pct, warnPct, critPct) if pct >= critPct then return "crit" elseif pct >= warnPct then return "warn" else return "ok" end end local function esc(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">") return s end -- Bar color per level. local LEVEL_COLOR = { ok = "#00f3ff", warn = "#fffb00", crit = "#ff007f" } local function renderRow(M, r, warnPct, critPct) if not r.ok then return string.format( '

', model.tick or 0, esc(model.build or "dev")) parts[#parts+1] = '' return table.concat(parts) end -- Config comes from explicit options (passed to start), never from globals -- -- DU's global table does not carry our values reliably. local function buildConfig(opts) opts = opts or {} local debug = opts.debug if debug == nil then debug = true end local hud = opts.hud if hud == nil then hud = true end return { refreshSeconds = opts.refreshSeconds or 5, warnPct = opts.warnPct or 75, critPct = opts.critPct or 90, sortMode = opts.sortMode or "fill-desc", title = opts.title or "BASE INVENTORY", debug = debug, hud = hud, build = opts.build or "dev", } end -- The board's link slots are DIRECT globals (slot1..slot10) referenced by name. -- Undefined ones read as nil (no error). local function rawSlots() local t = {} t[1] = slot1; t[2] = slot2; t[3] = slot3; t[4] = slot4; t[5] = slot5 t[6] = slot6; t[7] = slot7; t[8] = slot8; t[9] = slot9; t[10] = slot10 return t end -- Dense array of linked slots (nil/unlinked dropped) so # is reliable. local function gatherSlots() local raw = rawSlots() local slots = {} for i = 1, MAX_SLOTS do if raw[i] ~= nil then slots[#slots + 1] = raw[i] end end return slots end -- Build the current run environment by scanning + classifying the slots. local function env() local sc = M.classify(gatherSlots()) return { screen = sc.screen, containers = sc.containers, config = M.config, tick = M._tick } end -- Print the class + name reported by every linked slot (diagnostics). local function dumpSlots() local raw = rawSlots() for i = 1, MAX_SLOTS do local s = raw[i] if s ~= nil then local cls, nm = "?", "?" pcall(function() cls = tostring(s.getClass()) end) pcall(function() nm = tostring(s.getName()) end) dbg(string.format("slot%d: class=%s name=%s", i, cls, nm)) end end end function M.start(opts) M.config = buildConfig(opts) M.debug = M.config.debug M._tick = 0 dbg("===== Base Inventory Monitor build " .. tostring(M.config.build) .. "s") end dbg("onStart done") end function M.tick() M.config = M.config or buildConfig() M._tick = (M._tick or 0) + 1 local html = M.run(env()) dbg("tick #" .. M._tick .. " -> html len=" .. (html and #html or "nil")) end function M.run(e) local cfg = e.config or {} local title = cfg.title or "BASE INVENTORY" local warnPct = cfg.warnPct or 75 local critPct = cfg.critPct or 90 local rows = M.buildRows(e.containers or {}) M.sortRows(rows, cfg.sortMode or "fill-desc") local agg = M.aggregate(rows) local html = M.renderHTML({ title = title, warnPct = warnPct, critPct = critPct, tick = e.tick or 0, rows = rows, agg = agg, build = cfg.build, }) -- Push to a linked Screen element if one is present. if e.screen and e.screen.setHTML then pcall(function() e.screen.setHTML(html) end) end -- Mirror to the player HUD (visible when running the board explicitly with F). if cfg.hud and system and system.setScreen then pcall(function() system.setScreen(html) end) end return html end BIM.start({ refreshSeconds = refreshSeconds, warnPct = warnPct, critPct = critPct, sortMode = sortMode, title = title, debug = bimDebug, hud = bimHud, build = '1 (21:23:01)' })
